question: Should OpenClaw permanently support plugin-authored AI-safety events, a `safetyEventTypes` manifest permission, durable shared-state retention, and operator-queryable history as one core contract?
rationale: This is a new cross-boundary product and SDK commitment; code review cannot safely choose the public API, retention policy, or long-term ownership model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow core contract
options.body: Adopt the event seam with a documented plugin API, retention/privacy policy, and upgrade guarantees, then resolve the remaining documentation defect.

options.title: Split to approved instrumentation only
options.body: Keep only the owner-approved internal/core diagnostics and defer the plugin API, durable history, and operator UI/query surfaces to separately sponsored work.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the event seam with a documented plugin API, retention/privacy policy, and upgrade guarantees, then resolve the remaining documentation defect.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author specifically escalated this owner for the required plugin SDK and product-boundary choice.
